facts.claim: 在研究涉及的全部模型规模上，语义熵（按回答含义衡量不确定性的指标）均优于基线方法；P (True)似乎随模型规模增大而改善，作者仅据此推测，它可能在能力很强、诚实且充分理解任务情境的模型上更具竞争力。
facts.quote: Although semantic entropy outperforms the baselines across all model sizes, P (True) seems to improve with model size, suggesting that it might become more competitive for very capable honest models in settings that the model understands well (which are, however, not the most important cases to have good uncertainty).
facts.subject: semantic entropy
facts.condition: across all model sizes

facts.claim: 图2通过检测答案是否错误来评估方法，作者将其视为语义熵检测编造效果的下界。这些错误既包含编造造成的任意性错误，也包含语义熵不适合处理的错误，例如从训练数据中学到的一贯性错误。
facts.quote: The results in Fig. 2 offer a lower bound on the effectiveness of semantic entropy at detecting confabulations. These evaluations determine whether semantic entropy and baseline methods can detect when the answers of the model are incorrect (which we validate against human correctness evaluations in Supplementary Table 4). In addition to errors from confabulations (arbitrary incorrectness), this also includes other types of mistakes for which semantic entropy is not suited, such as consistent errors learned from the training data.
facts.subject: semantic entropy and baseline methods
facts.condition: when the answers of the model are incorrect

facts.claim: 表1第一行展示了含义相同、措辞不同的回答：语义熵将它们归入同一组，正确预测没有编造；朴素熵则错误预测存在编造。
facts.quote: The first row of Table 1 demonstrates a case in which semantic entropy correctly predicts that an answer is not a confabulation if naive entropy would incorrectly predict a confabulation. All of the generations from the model mean the same thing as each other so they are clustered together despite using different phrasings.
facts.subject: semantic entropy
facts.condition: All of the generations from the model mean the same thing as each other

facts.claim: 在表1最后一行，语义熵因语义聚类——把含义相近的回答归为一组——过于敏感而错误升高：方法将精确到日期的答案与仅给出年份的答案分开，而作者认为，在该问题情境下，这种差别可能无关紧要。
facts.quote: In the final row, we give an example in which semantic entropy is erroneously high as a result of overly sensitive semantic clustering relative to the reference answer. Our clustering method distinguishes the answers which provide a precise date from those which only provide a year. For some contexts that would have been correct but in this context the distinction between the specific day and the year is probably irrelevant.
facts.subject: semantic entropy
facts.condition: in this context

facts.claim: 为展示语义熵能用于整段文本，研究者使用GPT-4（v.0613）为21名人物生成传记，构建数据集；这些人物都有自己的维基百科页面，但网上没有详尽传记。
facts.quote: Nevertheless, we can use semantic entropy to detect confabulations in longer generations, such as entire paragraphs of text. T o show this, we develop a dataset of biographical generations from GPT-4 (v.0613) for 21 individuals notable enough to have their own Wikipedia page but without extensive online biographies.
facts.subject: 21 individuals
facts.condition: notable enough to have their own Wikipedia page but without extensive online biographies

facts.claim: 传记实验共包含150条关于人物的事实性陈述，由研究者人工标注为真或假。
facts.quote: factual claims about the individual (150 factual claims in total), which we manually label as true or false.
facts.subject: factual claims about the individual
facts.condition: in total

facts.claim: 直接依据前文重新生成传记中的每个句子会遇到问题：重采样句子可能转向不同方面，例如一次谈家庭、另一次谈职业。这种变化反映的可能是事实排列顺序的不确定性，而非事实本身的不确定性。
facts.quote: Naively, one might simply regenerate each sentence (conditioned on the text so far) and then compute semantic entropy over these regenerations. However, the resampled sentences often target different aspects of the biography: for example, one time describing family and the next time profession. This is analogous to the original problem semantic entropy was designed to resolve: the model is uncertain about the right ordering of facts, not about the facts themselves.
facts.subject: the resampled sentences
facts.condition: conditioned on the text so far

facts.claim: 研究者将整段传记拆成事实性陈述，再重构这些陈述可能回答的问题。每个问题生成三个新答案，与原始陈述一起计算语义熵；随后对各问题的语义熵取平均，为每条命题得到一个用于检测编造的不确定性分数。
facts.quote: T o address this, we break down the entire paragraph into factual claims and reconstruct questions which might have been answered by those claims. Only then do we apply semantic entropy (Fig. 1) by generating three new answers to each question (selected with analysis in Supplementary Figs. 3 and 4) and computing the semantic entropy over those generations plus the original factual claim. We aggregate these by averaging the semantic entropy over all the questions to get an uncertainty score for each proposition, which we use to detect confabulations.
facts.subject: we
facts.condition: to each question

facts.claim: 由于写作时无法获取GPT-4生成内容的概率，研究使用离散语义熵：仅依据生成结果，近似估计各类语义含义出现的经验分布，从而只用模型输出即可计算。
facts.quote: As GPT-4 did not allow access to the probability of the generation at the time of writing, we use a discrete variant of semantic entropy which makes the further approximation that we can infer a discrete empirical distribution over semantic meaning clusters from only the generations (Methods). This allows us to compute semantic entropy using only the black-box outputs of an LLM.
facts.subject: a discrete variant of semantic entropy
facts.condition: at the time of writing

facts.claim: 由于缺少GPT-4的输出概率和嵌入表示，研究者无法在该模型上计算朴素熵基线、标准语义熵估计量或嵌入回归基线。
facts.quote: However, we were unable to compute the naive entropy baseline, the standard semantic entropy estimator or the embedding regression baseline for GPT-4 without output probabilities and embeddings.
facts.subject: we
facts.metric: the naive entropy baseline, the standard semantic entropy estimator or the embedding regression baseline
facts.condition: for GPT-4 without output probabilities and embeddings

facts.claim: 在GPT-4段落长度传记数据集上，离散语义熵的AUROC和AURAC这两项检测排序评价指标均高于自检基线及适配段落任务的P(True)变体。按不确定性拒绝部分问题后比较剩余答案的准确率，离散语义熵在拒绝比例达到20%之前表现更好；到20%时，P(True)略占优势。检测排序指标不能等同于答案准确率。
facts.quote: In Fig. 3 we show that the discrete variant of semantic entropy effectively detects confabulations on this dataset. Its AUROC and AURAC are higher than either a simple ‘self-check’ baseline—which just asks the LLM whether the factoid is likely to be true—or a variant of P(True) which has been adapted to work for the paragraph-length setting. Discrete semantic entropy has better rejection accuracy performance until 20% of the questions have been rejected at which point P(True) has a narrow edge. This indicates that the questions predicted to cause confabulations are indeed more likely to be wrong.
facts.subject: the discrete variant of semantic entropy
facts.condition: on this dataset

facts.claim: 该方法不直接处理模型自信但错误的情况，包括训练目标系统性地导致危险行为、系统性推理错误或系统性误导用户的情况。作者认为这些现象虽然表面相似，但底层机制不同，需要分别处理。
facts.quote:
Our method explicitly does not directly address situations in which LLMs are confidently wrong because they have been trained with objectives that systematically produce dangerous behaviour, cause systematic reasoning errors or are systematically mislead -
ing the user. We believe that these represent different underlying mechanisms—despite similar ‘symptoms’—and need to be handled separately.
facts.subject: Our method
facts.condition: situations in which LLMs are confidently wrong

facts.claim: 语义熵作为应对虚构性陈述的策略，建立在不确定性估计的概率工具之上，可直接用于语言模型或类似基础模型，不需要修改模型架构。
facts.quote: Semantic entropy as a strategy for overcoming confabulation builds on probabilistic tools for uncertainty estimation. It can be applied directly to any LLM or similar foundation model without requiring any modifications to the architecture.
facts.subject: any LLM or similar foundation model
facts.condition: without requiring any modifications to the architecture

facts.claim: 离散变体即使在无法获得生成结果的预测概率时也可使用，例如模型内部信息访问受限时。
facts.quote: Our ‘discrete’ variant of semantic uncertainty can be applied even when the predicted probabilities for the generations are not available, for example, because access to the internals of the model is limited.
facts.subject: Our ‘discrete’ variant of semantic uncertainty
facts.metric: the predicted probabilities for the generations
facts.condition: when the predicted probabilities for the generations are not available

facts.claim: 研究目标是利用模型对任意生成结果的不确定性，检测大型语言模型中的虚构性陈述。
facts.quote: We aim to detect confabulations in LLMs, using the principle that the model will be uncertain about generations for which its output is going to be arbitrary.
facts.subject: the model
facts.condition: generations for which its output is going to be arbitrary

facts.claim: 预测熵低表示输出分布高度集中；预测熵高表示许多可能输出的概率相近。
facts.quote: A low predictive entropy indicates an output distribution which is heavily concentrated whereas a high predictive entropy indicates that many possible outputs are similarly likely.
facts.subject: A low predictive entropy
facts.condition: a high predictive entropy

facts.claim: 作者在分析中不区分偶然不确定性与认知不确定性；进一步发展能够区分这两类不确定性的估计方法，可拓展语义不确定性方法的应用潜力。
facts.quote: We do not distinguish between aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty in our analysis. Researchers sometimes separate aleatoric uncertainty (uncertainty in the underlying data distribution) from epistemic uncertainty (caused by having only limited information)46. Further advances in uncertainty estimation which separate these kinds of uncertainty would enhance the potential for our semantic uncertainty approach by allowing extensions beyond entropy.
facts.subject: We
facts.condition: in our analysis

facts.claim: 作者指出，长度归一化虽有一些经验上的成功，但在文献中缺乏充分的理论依据。
facts.quote: Length normalization has some empirical success48, including in our own preliminary experiments, but little theoretical justification in the literature.
facts.subject: Length normalization
facts.condition: including in our own preliminary experiments

facts.claim: 即使模型确信生成内容的含义，表达同一含义的措辞仍可能有很多种，因此直接计算预测熵会混淆对答案含义和具体用词的不确定性。
facts.quote: For example, even if the model is confident in the meaning of a generation, there are still usually many different ways for phrasing that generation without changing its meaning.
facts.subject: the model
facts.condition: even if the model is confident in the meaning of a generation

facts.claim: 语义不确定性方法旨在估计模型对生成内容含义的不确定性，而不是对措辞选择的不确定性。
facts.quote: Our semantic uncertainty method therefore seeks to estimate only the uncertainty the LLM has over the meaning of its generation, not the choice of words.
facts.subject: Our semantic uncertainty method
facts.metric: the uncertainty the LLM has over the meaning of its generation

facts.claim: 方法包含生成、按含义聚类、熵估计三个步骤；聚类依据双向蕴含，熵估计时合并表达同一含义的序列概率并计算其熵。
facts.quote:
1. Generation: sample output sequences of tokens from the predictive distribution of a LLM given a context x.
2. Clustering: cluster sequences by their meaning using our clustering algorithm based on bidirectional entailment.
3. Entropy estimation: estimate semantic entropy by summing probabilities of sequences that share a meaning following equation (2) and compute their entropy.
facts.subject: sequences
facts.condition: given a context x

facts.claim: 作者从单个模型采样多条序列，只改变从词元概率中采样所用的随机种子，并记录序列的词元概率。
facts.quote: We sample all our generations from a single model, varying only the random seed used for sampling from the token probabilities.
facts.subject: all our generations
facts.condition: from a single model

facts.claim: 作者还以低温度（0.1）采样一次生成，将其作为模型对输入的“最佳生成”估计，并用来评估模型准确性。
facts.quote: We also sample a single generation at low temperature (0.1) as an estimate of the ‘best generation’ of the model to the context, which we use to assess the accuracy of the model.
facts.subject: a single generation
facts.condition: at low temperature

facts.claim: 研究用双向蕴含判断两个回答是否表达相同含义：两段文字须相互逻辑推出；判断还要结合问题语境。
facts.quote:
A sequence, s, means the same thing as a second sequence, 
s′, only if the sequences entail (that is, logically imply) each other.
facts.subject: A sequence, s
facts.condition: only if the sequences entail (that is, logically imply) each other

facts.claim: 材料以法国首都问题说明语境会影响回答是否蕴含另一种表述：单独的“Paris”不蕴含完整陈述，但在相应问题语境下可以。
facts.quote: But in the context of the question ‘What is the capital of France?’ , the one-word answer does entail the longer answer.
facts.subject: the one-word answer
facts.condition: in the context of the question ‘What is the capital of France?’

facts.claim: 研究按回答之间是否双向蕴含来聚类；若一个回答与已有簇中的任何回答都不共享含义，就单独成簇。
facts.quote:
We then cluster sentences according to whether they bidirection-
ally entail each other using the algorithm presented in Extended Data
Fig. 1.
facts.subject: sentences
facts.condition: according to whether they bidirectionally entail each other

facts.claim: 语义熵通过各含义类别的概率分布估计不确定性；由于无法取得所有可能类别，研究用类别抽样估计该分布。
facts.quote:
There is a complication which prevents direct computation: we do
not have access to every possible meaning-class c. Instead, we can only
sample c from the sequence-generating distribution induced by the
model.
facts.subject: we
facts.condition: we do not have access to every possible meaning-class c

facts.claim: 作者报告离散语义熵在经验表现上与语义熵相近。
facts.quote:
We find that discrete seman-
tic entropy results in similar performance empirically.
facts.subject: discrete semantic entropy
facts.condition: empirically

facts.claim: 实验用语义不确定性预测模型准确性，并研究拒答高语义不确定性问题能否提高准确性。
facts.quote:
In our experiments, we use semantic uncertainty to predict model accuracy, demonstrating that confabula-
tions make up a notable fraction of model mistakes. We further show that semantic uncertainty can be used to improve model accuracy by refusing to answer questions when semantic uncertainty is high.
facts.subject: semantic uncertainty
facts.condition: by refusing to answer questions when semantic uncertainty is high

facts.claim: 研究用AUROC、拒绝准确率和AURAC评估方法；AUROC衡量随机抽取的正确答案获得比随机抽取的错误答案更高置信分数的概率。
facts.quote:
The AUROC can be interpreted as the probability
that a randomly chosen correct answer has been assigned a higher con-
fidence score than a randomly chosen incorrect answer. For a perfect
classifier, this is 1.
facts.subject: The AUROC
facts.condition: For a perfect classifier

facts.claim: 拒绝准确率是在不确定性方法识别出的最有把握输入子集上的问答准确率；方法有效时，拒答更多输入应使该指标上升。
facts.quote:
Second, we compute the ‘rejection accuracy at X %’ , which is the
question-answering accuracy of the model on the most-confident
X% of the inputs as identified by the respective uncertainty method.
facts.subject: the model
facts.condition: on the most-confident X% of the inputs as identified by the respective uncertainty method

facts.claim: 句子长度回答的正确与否由GPT-4将模型回答与参考答案比较并判断两者在问题语境中是否含义相同。
facts.quote: For sentence-length generations, we therefore automatically determine whether an answer to the question is correct or incorrect by using GPT-4 to compare the given answer to the reference answer.
facts.subject: we
facts.condition: For sentence-length generations

facts.claim: 在该数据集中，研究者认为自动拆分出的事实主张在所有情况下都与人工判断一致。
facts.quote: We found that we agreed with the decompositions in all cases in the dataset.
facts.subject: we
facts.condition: in the dataset

facts.claim: 研究者为每条拆分出的事实生成六个问题，每次提示生成三个问题，并提示模型避免是非题、让问题和答案多样且答案尽可能简短。
facts.subject: the model
facts.condition: for each of the facts from the decomposition

facts.claim: 生成的问题不一定能准确命中目标；问题生成这一步的难度是该流程产生错误的主要来源，问题有时也会漏掉事实中显而易见的方面。
facts.quote: These questions are not necessarily well-targeted and the difficulty of this step is the main source of errors in the procedure. We generate three questions with each prompt, as this encourages diversity of the questions, each question targeting a different aspect of the fact. However, we observed that the generated questions will sometimes miss obvious aspects of the fact.
facts.subject: These questions
facts.condition: in the procedure

facts.claim: 针对每个问题生成三条新答案，并把这些答案与原始事实主张一同用于计算语义熵；纳入原始事实是为了让估计量以原主张为依据，并帮助发现问题被完全按另一种语境理解的情况。
facts.quote: We then compute the semantic entropy over these answers plus the original factual claim. Including the original fact ensures that the estimator remains grounded in the original claim and helps detect situations in which the question has been interpreted completely differently from the original context.
facts.subject: the estimator
facts.condition: over these answers plus the original factual claim

facts.claim: 如果超过一半的答案包含“not available”“not provided”“unknown”或“unclear”之一，研究者就将语义不确定性视为最大。
facts.quote: If more than half of the answers include one of the strings ‘not available’ , ‘not provided’ , ‘unknown’ or ‘unclear’ then we treat the semantic uncertainty as maximal.
facts.subject: we
facts.condition: of the answers include one of the strings ‘not available’ , ‘not provided’ , ‘unknown’ or ‘unclear’

facts.claim: 作者称，尽管该方法包含额外假设且更复杂，它仍大幅优于基线方法。
facts.quote: Despite the extra assumptions and complexity, we find that this method greatly outperforms the baselines.
facts.subject: this method
facts.condition: Despite the extra assumptions and complexity

issues.article_quote: 计算语义熵时，除了这些新答案，还加入原始事实陈述，使比较始终围绕原来的主张进行。
issues.evidence_quote: Including the original fact ensures that the estimator remains grounded in the original claim and helps detect situations in which the question has been interpreted completely differently from the original context.
issues.reason: 原文说明，加入原始事实可使估计以原主张为依据，并帮助发现问题被按完全不同语境理解的情况；这并不保证比较过程始终围绕原主张展开。“始终”把保留参照依据的作用扩大为避免语境偏离的保证，也与文章后文承认问题可能偏离原陈述的限制不一致。
issues.suggestion: 改为“计算语义熵时，除了这些新答案，还加入原始事实陈述，让估计保留对原主张的参照，并帮助发现问题被按不同语境理解的情况。”
